authorization.payload_transfer: User explicitly approved sending synthetic fixtures to https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions.
authorization.failed_attempt_policy: First failed attempt retained and counted; never retried.

method.matching: phase/scene_id/locale/route, verified payload_sha256 and byte size; reserialized payload matches hash; historical estimate exactly bytes+256+64*messages
method.data_handling: Only metadata and aggregate metrics emitted; no prompts/dialogues/responses printed or copied into report.

limitations: One historical endpoint/requested-model/settings family, frozen synthetic corpus, one sample per arm/case. Raw upstream model/provider identity not captured beyond requested model and endpoint hash; no current model tokenizer truth, guarantee or exact upper bound.
Reasoning effort none; usage captures only input_tokens/output_tokens/total_tokens. No cached-token, hidden-reasoning, or raw native usage detail. Absence is unknown, not zero.
Missing before greeting_low_trust/ru timeout usage unknown; exclude from ratios/totals, preserve attempt count.
Four offline diagnostics per arm excluded from live; long_context selections changed across arms, so deltas not instruction-only.
Pure offline divided-byte candidates are descriptive sample fits, not deployment recommendation/bound. No network/provider/tokenizer calls performed.
